name: LX Semicon Co., Ltd.
summary: Established in 1999, the company, initially operating as Silicon Works Co., Ltd., rebranded as LX Semicon Co., Ltd. in June 2021. This semiconductor firm, headquartered in Daejeon, South Korea, maintains a significant international presence, with operations spanning South Korea, China, Vietnam, Taiwan, Japan, and other global markets. LX Semicon's extensive product portfolio encompasses a wide array of integrated circuits (ICs) and components. These include display driver ICs for Organic Light Emitting Diode (OLED) and Liquid Crystal Display (LCD) technologies, along with RealTouch, an innovative in-cell touch solution for display panels. The company also provides timing controllers for both OLED and LCD systems, video processors, power management ICs, and level shifters. Furthermore, their offerings extend to general and motor microcontroller units (MCUs), motor and gate driver ICs, and thermal management products like metallized ceramic substrates and heat dissipation materials. These advanced solutions are critical across diverse applications, powering devices such as mobile phones, tablets, smartwatches, televisions, virtual reality (VR) systems, monitors, and notebooks. Beyond consumer electronics, their technology is integral to home appliances like refrigerators, washing machines, and air conditioners, as well as within the automotive sector.
